$comment: Release validation report (DD-25), config of this repo for validation-report.mjs (same script in deepdots-popup-sdk and deepdots-popup-mobile-native-sdk). Test ids come from playwright-results.mjs: '<describe without the SDK prefix> › <test title>'. Each category matches them by regex ('match'); validation-report.test.mjs fails if a test of the suite is in no category. 'safety' = host-page safety checks of section 4.
intro: SDK {version} was validated as published on npm, loaded from the CDN by a test store that integrates it the same way a customer site does, on desktop and mobile Chromium.
environmentNote: All automated tests ran against the Deepdots development environment with test companies only. No customer data was used, and the test store blocks and fails on any request to the production API.
limitations: Automated on Chromium (desktop, and mobile with Pixel 7 emulation). Safari and Firefox are checked by hand (section 7).
On mobile the host-safety and popup layout suites run; triggers and navigation run on desktop and use the same code path.
Visual regression (screenshot comparison) is not yet automated for the web SDK.
Tests marked as known issues are expected to fail until their fix ships; if one passes, the run fails so the mark is removed.

realDevices.intro: Filled in by hand after this report is generated: the test store with this exact version in the browsers the automated suite does not run.
